messages.message: Hello, I purchased the Complete Python Programming course on November 10, but I am unable to access the recorded video lectures.
Hello! Thank you for contacting support. Are you able to log in to your learning account successfully?
Yes, I can log in. I can see the course dashboard, but when I click on any video, the player keeps loading.
Please clear your browser cache and cookies, then try opening the course again.
I cleared the cache and also tried another browser. The same problem is happening.
Could you please tell us which browser and device you are using?
I am using Chrome on my Windows laptop. Other websites and videos are working normally.
Thank you. I have forwarded your issue to our technical team for investigation.
Please resolve this quickly because my Python exam is next week. When will I be able to access the videos?

expected_summary.issue: Recorded videos in the Complete Python Programming course are not loading.
unresolved_questions: When will video access be restored?
expected_summary.next_action: Technical team should investigate the video playback issue and provide an update.

messages.message: I enrolled in the Data Science with Python course on November 5. Initially everything was working fine, but since yesterday three modules are showing as locked.
Could you share the names of the modules that are locked?
Pandas Advanced, Data Visualization and Introduction to Machine Learning. I have already completed all previous modules.
Please check whether all previous lessons are marked as completed in your dashboard.
Yes, all previous lessons show 100% completion. I also logged out and logged in again.
Did you receive any notification regarding a course update or payment?
No notification. My payment was successful when I purchased the course. I have the payment receipt.
Please share the course enrollment ID and payment reference through the approved support channel so we can verify the account.
My enrollment ID is ENR-002. I need these modules because my assessment is scheduled for November 22.
We have forwarded the access issue to the course administration team.

expected_summary.issue: Three Data Science course modules are locked despite completion of previous modules.
steps_tried: Logged out and logged in again
expected_summary.current_status: Unresolved; forwarded to course administration team.
unresolved_questions: Why are the three modules locked?
When will access be restored?
expected_summary.next_action: Verify enrollment and payment records and investigate module access.

messages.message: I purchased the Advanced Excel course last month. The course dashboard shows that I have access, but the downloadable practice files are missing.
Are you facing this issue with every module or only specific lessons?
I checked five modules. None of them has a working download button.
Please try accessing the course from a desktop browser instead of the mobile application.
I tried Chrome on my laptop. The download buttons are visible, but clicking them does nothing.
Do you see any error message?
No error message appears. The page simply stays the same.
We have reported this issue to the content management team.
I need the practice files before my assessment on November 25. Please tell me if they can be shared another way.

expected_summary.issue: Downloadable practice files are unavailable in the Advanced Excel course.
steps_tried: Tried accessing through Chrome on a laptop
expected_summary.current_status: Unresolved; reported to content management team.
unresolved_questions: Can the practice files be shared through an alternative method?
expected_summary.next_action: Investigate broken download buttons and provide access to the practice files.

messages.message: I paid Rs. 4,999 for the Machine Learning course, but my account still shows the payment as pending.
Please tell us when you completed the payment and which payment method you used.
I paid on November 11 using UPI. The amount was deducted from my bank account immediately.
Sometimes payment confirmation takes some time. Please wait for a few hours.
It has already been more than 24 hours. I also received a successful payment notification from my bank.
Did you receive an order confirmation email from our platform?
No, I did not receive any confirmation email. My bank transaction was successful.
Please provide the transaction reference through our approved support channel. We will ask the payment team to verify it.
I need course access urgently. Should I make another payment or wait for the existing payment to be confirmed?

expected_summary.issue: Rs. 4,999 UPI payment was deducted, but the Machine Learning course enrollment remains pending.
unresolved_questions: Should the learner make another payment or wait?
expected_summary.next_action: Verify the UPI transaction with the payment team and update the enrollment status. Do not request another payment before verification.

messages.message: I accidentally purchased the wrong course. I wanted Python for Data Science, but I purchased Java Programming.
When did you purchase the course?
I purchased it yesterday, November 10. I have not started any lessons.
Would you prefer a course exchange or a refund?
I would prefer an exchange to Python for Data Science. I do not want to lose the amount I paid.
We need to check whether your purchase is eligible for a course exchange.
Please confirm if the exchange is possible and whether I need to pay any additional amount.
Your request has been forwarded to the course administration team for review.
I have not accessed the Java course at all. Please update me as soon as possible.

expected_summary.issue: Learner purchased Java Programming instead of Python for Data Science and requested a course exchange.
steps_tried: Confirmed that no lessons have been accessed
expected_summary.current_status: Exchange request forwarded for review; eligibility not confirmed.
unresolved_questions: Is the exchange possible?
Will an additional payment be required?
expected_summary.next_action: Review the exchange request and confirm eligibility and any price difference.

messages.message: I requested a refund for my Web Development course on November 3, but I have not received the amount yet.
Could you confirm whether you received a refund request confirmation?
Yes, I received an email saying my refund request was submitted successfully.
Was the refund request approved or is it still under review?
The email says it is under review. I have not received any further communication.
Please check whether your original payment method is still active.
Yes, the original bank account is active. I paid using a debit card.
We have asked the finance team to check the refund status.
Can you confirm the expected refund date? I need to plan my expenses.

expected_summary.issue: Refund for the Web Development course has not been received.
steps_tried: Confirmed original debit card account is active
expected_summary.current_status: Refund request is under review; finance team contacted.
unresolved_questions: What is the expected refund date?
expected_summary.next_action: Finance team should verify refund status and communicate the expected timeline.

messages.message: I am unable to log in to my account. It says that my email or password is incorrect.
Please check whether you are using the same email address that you used during registration.
Yes, I am using my registered email address. I am sure the password is correct.
Please use the Forgot Password option to reset your password.
I requested a password reset, but I have not received the reset email.
Please check your spam and junk folders.
I checked both folders. There is no reset email. I also tried requesting it three times.
We will check whether there is an issue with your registered account.
I have an assignment deadline tomorrow. Please help me restore account access.

expected_summary.issue: Learner cannot log in and is not receiving password reset emails.
unresolved_questions: Why are password reset emails not being delivered?
expected_summary.next_action: Verify the learner account and investigate password reset email delivery.

messages.message: I changed my registered email address last week. Since then, I am not receiving course notifications or assignment reminders.
Did you receive a confirmation message after changing your email address?
Yes, I clicked the verification link and received a message saying my email was updated.
Please check your notification preferences in account settings.
All notification preferences are enabled. I also checked my spam folder.
Are you able to receive other emails from our support team?
Yes, I received your previous support email, but I am not receiving automated course notifications.
We will ask our technical team to check the notification service.
My assignment reminder is important. Can you confirm whether my notifications are working now?

expected_summary.issue: Automated course notifications and assignment reminders are not reaching the learner after an email address change.
unresolved_questions: Are automated notifications working now?
expected_summary.next_action: Investigate automated email delivery to the updated learner email address.

messages.message: My account gets logged out automatically every few minutes while I am watching recorded lectures.
Does this happen on a particular browser or across different browsers?
It happens on Chrome and Edge. I am using a Windows 11 laptop.
Please check whether multiple devices are logged into your account.
I checked. My account is only logged in on this laptop.
Please update your browser and try again.
Both browsers are updated. I also restarted my laptop, but the problem continues.
We have forwarded this session issue to our technical team.
I have to watch long lectures. Please check whether there is a session timeout problem.

expected_summary.issue: Learner is automatically logged out while watching recorded lectures.
unresolved_questions: Is the automatic logout caused by a session timeout issue?
expected_summary.next_action: Investigate session management and authentication timeout behavior.

messages.message: I submitted my Python assignment on November 4, but the dashboard still shows it as not submitted.
Did you receive a submission confirmation after uploading the assignment?
Yes, the upload reached 100%, and I saw a submission successful message.
Please refresh your dashboard and check the assignment section again.
I refreshed the page and logged in again. It still shows the assignment as pending.
Could you confirm the assignment name?
It is Python Data Analysis Assignment 3. The deadline is November 8.
We have forwarded your submission status issue to the academic support team.
I do not want to lose marks because of this technical problem. Can you confirm whether my submission was received?

expected_summary.issue: Python Data Analysis Assignment 3 shows as pending despite a successful upload message.
unresolved_questions: Was the assignment successfully stored?
Will the submission be considered before the November 8 deadline?
expected_summary.next_action: Verify the assignment submission record and confirm its timestamp with academic support.

messages.message: I completed all the lessons in my Digital Marketing course, but I cannot download my certificate.
Have you completed the final assessment as well?
Yes, I scored 85% in the final assessment and passed it.
Please check whether all course modules show completed status.
All modules show 100% completion. The certificate section says certificate generation is pending.
Please wait for some time because certificate generation may take a while.
It has been three days. I need the certificate for a job application.
We have forwarded your certificate generation issue to the certification team.
Please tell me when I can download it.

expected_summary.issue: Digital Marketing certificate is not available despite course completion and passing the final assessment with 85%.
expected_summary.current_status: Certificate generation pending for three days; forwarded to certification team.
unresolved_questions: When will the certificate be available?
expected_summary.next_action: Verify completion eligibility and investigate certificate generation.

messages.message: I submitted my assignment two weeks ago, but it has not been evaluated yet.
Could you share the assignment name and submission date?
It is the Machine Learning Model Evaluation assignment. I submitted it on October 21.
The usual evaluation process can take some time. Please check again later.
I understand, but my classmates who submitted on the same day have already received their grades.
Have you received any feedback or evaluation notification?
No. The assignment status still says pending evaluation.
We will contact the academic team to check your submission.
I have another course assessment next week. Please let me know when my grade will be available.

expected_summary.issue: Machine Learning Model Evaluation assignment has remained pending since October 21.
steps_tried: Compared status with classmates who submitted on the same date
unresolved_questions: When will the assignment be evaluated and graded?
expected_summary.next_action: Academic team should verify the submission and provide an evaluation timeline.

messages.message: The Python coding environment is not executing my code. Whenever I click Run, it keeps showing the loading indicator.
Are you receiving any error message?
Sometimes it says Kernel disconnected. Other times it keeps loading without showing any result.
Please restart the coding environment and try running a simple print statement.
I restarted it and tried print('Hello World'). The kernel disconnected again.
Please try accessing the coding environment from another browser.
I tried Edge and Chrome. The issue is the same. My internet connection is stable.
We have escalated this issue to the engineering team.
I have a practical exam on November 10. Can you provide an alternative coding environment until this is fixed?

expected_summary.issue: Online Python coding environment repeatedly disconnects its kernel and fails to execute code.
unresolved_questions: Can an alternative coding environment be provided until the issue is fixed?
expected_summary.next_action: Investigate kernel disconnections and provide a temporary alternative for practical exam preparation.

messages.message: I am unable to upload my project report. The file size is 8 MB, and the portal shows an upload failed error.
What file format are you trying to upload?
It is a PDF file. The assignment portal accepts PDF according to the instructions.
Please try compressing the PDF and uploading it again.
I compressed it to 3 MB, but the upload still fails.
Could you try using a different browser?
I tried Firefox as well. I get the same upload failed error.
We have reported this issue to the technical team.
The deadline is November 5. Can I submit the report through another approved method if the portal remains unavailable?

expected_summary.issue: PDF project report upload fails in the assignment portal.
steps_tried: Compressed PDF from 8 MB to 3 MB
unresolved_questions: Can the report be submitted through an alternative approved method?
expected_summary.next_action: Investigate upload failure and confirm an approved alternative submission method before the November 5 deadline.

messages.message: The course videos are playing without sound. I can see the video, but there is no audio.
Please check your device volume and browser sound settings.
My volume is working. I tested YouTube and other video websites, and they have sound.
Please try another lesson in the same course.
I tried four lessons. None of them has audio.
Please clear your browser cache and restart the browser.
I did that, but there is still no audio. I also tried the mobile application.
We have escalated the media playback issue to the technical team.
I cannot understand the lessons without audio. Please provide an update.

expected_summary.issue: Course videos play without audio across multiple lessons.
steps_tried: Checked device volume and browser sound settings
unresolved_questions: When will course audio be restored?
expected_summary.next_action: Investigate course media audio delivery and provide a status update.

messages.message: I am facing two problems with my Full Stack Development course. First, some React lessons are locked. Second, I cannot download the project resources.
Could you tell us which React lessons are locked?
React Hooks and State Management are locked even though I completed the previous module.
Please check whether your course progress shows the previous module as completed.
It shows 100% completion. I logged out and logged in again, but the lessons remain locked.
Regarding project resources, are you able to see the download buttons?
Yes, the buttons are visible, but clicking them does not download anything.
Please try a desktop browser and check both issues again.
I am already using Chrome on my laptop. Both problems continue.
We have created a technical support request for both problems.
My project submission is due on November 7. I need the locked lessons and resource files before then.

expected_summary.issue: Two Full Stack Development course issues: React lessons remain locked and project resources cannot be downloaded.
steps_tried: Logged out and logged in again
Tested downloads in Chrome on a laptop
expected_summary.current_status: Both issues unresolved; technical support request created.
unresolved_questions: When will the React lessons be unlocked?
How can project resources be downloaded?
expected_summary.next_action: Investigate lesson access and resource download failures separately, prioritizing the November 7 deadline.

messages.message: I enrolled in the Data Analytics course, but my profile shows the wrong course name and my payment status is still pending.
Could you explain what course name appears in your profile?
I purchased Data Analytics with Python, but the dashboard shows Introduction to Excel.
Did you receive a purchase confirmation email?
No confirmation email, but my payment was deducted successfully.
Please verify your transaction details through the approved support channel.
I checked my bank statement. The amount was deducted on October 29.
We will ask the payment and course administration teams to review your account.
I do not want to lose access to the course I purchased. Please confirm whether my payment and enrollment are correctly linked.
Your request has been forwarded for verification. We do not have a confirmed resolution yet.

expected_summary.issue: Learner purchased Data Analytics with Python but sees Introduction to Excel, while payment status remains pending.
steps_tried: Verified bank statement and payment deduction date
expected_summary.current_status: Unresolved; payment and course administration teams asked to investigate.
unresolved_questions: Is the payment correctly linked to the intended course enrollment?
expected_summary.next_action: Verify payment transaction and correct course mapping before changing enrollment records.

messages.message: Hello, I am facing a problem with my course.
Hello! We are happy to help. Could you please explain the issue in detail?
The course is not working properly.
Are you unable to log in, access videos, submit assignments, or use another feature?
I am not sure. Something is wrong when I open it.

expected_summary.issue: Learner reports a general course problem, but the specific issue is unclear.
unresolved_questions: Which course is affected?
What exactly happens when the learner opens the course?
Is an error message displayed?

messages.message: I was unable to download my course completion certificate yesterday.
Please try logging out and logging in again. Also check whether your course is marked as completed.

It is working now. I successfully downloaded the certificate.
Thank you for confirming. Is there anything else we can help you with?
No, everything is fine now. Thank you for your help.

steps_tried: Logged out and logged in again

messages.message: I purchased the Artificial Intelligence Engineering program on October 10. Since enrollment, I have experienced several problems. Initially, I could not access the Python fundamentals module.
We apologize for the inconvenience. Could you confirm whether you can access the course dashboard?
Yes, the dashboard works. The Python module was locked even though my payment was successful. After two days, access was restored.
Thank you for confirming. Are you facing any other issues now?
Yes. My NLP assignment submission is showing pending even though I uploaded the file on October 20. I also received an upload confirmation message.
Please refresh the assignment page and check whether the submission status changes.
I refreshed it several times and also logged in from another browser. The status remains pending.
We have forwarded the assignment status issue to academic support.
There is another problem. My course progress shows 72%, but I have completed almost all the lessons. Only two optional videos are remaining.
Please check whether the remaining mandatory lessons and quizzes show completed status.
All mandatory lessons and quizzes show completed. Only two optional videos are left.
We will ask the course administration team to verify your progress calculation.
My final project evaluation is scheduled for November 5. I am worried that the pending assignment and incorrect progress percentage may affect my eligibility.
We have created separate requests for the assignment status and course progress issues. Both are awaiting investigation.
Please confirm whether my assignment submission from October 20 is available in your system and whether my 72% progress will affect the final project evaluation.
We cannot confirm these details until the academic and course administration teams complete their verification.

expected_summary.issue: Artificial Intelligence Engineering learner has two current issues: NLP assignment shows pending despite successful upload, and course progress displays 72% despite completion of mandatory lessons and quizzes. Earlier Python module access issue was resolved.
steps_tried: Confirmed Python module access was restored
Verified mandatory lessons and quizzes are completed
expected_summary.current_status: Two issues unresolved. Assignment issue forwarded to academic support; progress issue forwarded to course administration. Earlier module access issue resolved.
unresolved_questions: Is the October 20 NLP assignment stored successfully?
Will the displayed 72% progress affect final project evaluation on November 5?
expected_summary.next_action: Academic support should verify the assignment record and course administration should audit progress calculation. Confirm evaluation eligibility before November 5.
